description:
Rework the swarm-manager graph sidebar from a simple activity feed into a full navigation surface with search, filtering, sorting, and tabbed views.

## Context

The current sidebar (surfaces/graph/components/Sidebar.tsx) is a read-only activity feed built from captures and backlog items via lib/feed.ts. It has no search, no filtering, no sorting controls, and no way to browse specific entity types. On mobile it's an 85vw overlay (max 320px) that doesn't feel like a native app experience.

App-issue-tracker had text search (with optional Qdrant semantic search), filtering by status/priority/type, and export capabilities. As swarm-manager's backlog grows, the feed-only sidebar becomes inadequate for finding specific items.

## Expected Deliverables

### Search
1. **Search bar**: Persistent at the top of the sidebar, above tabs. Uses the existing searchDebounceMs setting. Searches across the active tab's content (title, description, tags for backlog; text for captures; name/title for initiatives).

2. **Search implementation**: Client-side filtering for now (the full backlog is already loaded into the store). The API already supports text filtering on the backlog list endpoint. No semantic/vector search in this item - that's a future enhancement.

### Tabs
3. **Tab bar**: Horizontally scrollable tab bar below the search bar. Tabs: Activity (default), Backlog, Captures, Initiatives, Executions. Use CSS overflow-x: auto with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory. Hide the scrollbar visually but keep it functional.

4. **Activity tab**: Current feed behavior (merged captures + backlog with priority sorting). This remains the default landing view.

5. **Entity tabs**: Each shows a filtered list of that entity type with relevant metadata (status badges, priority indicators, timestamps). Backlog tab should show kind icons. Executions tab should show running/completed/failed status with timing info.

### Filtering & Sorting
6. **Filter controls**: Collapsible filter section below tabs (collapsed by default). For Backlog tab: status, priority range, kind, tags. For Captures: classification status. For Executions: status, mode. Use compact chip-style toggles, not full dropdowns.

7. **Sort controls**: Sort by priority, recency, status, alphabetical. Small sort-direction toggle.

### Mobile Experience
8. **Full viewport width**: Change from w-[85vw] max-w-[320px] to w-full on mobile. The sidebar should feel like a full-screen app page, not a slide-over panel.

9. **Disable input zoom**: Add meta viewport maximum-scale=1, ensure search input has font-size: 16px (prevents iOS zoom), add touch-action: manipulation to the sidebar container.

10. **App-like feel**: When sidebar is open on mobile, it's the entire screen. The graph is behind it and not interactive. Tapping an item navigates to the graph with that node selected and closes the sidebar.

### Desktop
11. **Same 320px width**: Keep the existing desktop width. The new controls stack above the feed/list content. If the controls take too much vertical space, the filter section should be collapsible.

### Integration
12. **Graph node selection**: Clicking an item in any tab should select the corresponding node in the graph (using the existing onItemClick → selectNode pattern).

13. **URL state**: Active tab and any active filters should be preserved in URL params for shareability and back-button support.
name: swarm-manager-sidebar-search
title: Add Search, Filtering, Tabs, and Full-Viewport Mobile to the Graph Sidebar
